summary: Solid, well-structured solution with good GitHub Actions and PowerShell practices. Minor issues: (1) PowerShell scripts missing Set-StrictMode -Version Latest and #Requires directives (industry standard for safety); (2) run-act-tests.sh hardcodes expected labels as strings in CASES array (lines 25-28), creating brittleness if fixtures change without matching expected-value updates; (3) Bash assertions (lines 81-95) are separate if-blocks without consolidated error handling. Strengths: excellent documentation, proper module separation, real act-based testing, least-privilege permissions, sensible job dependencies, clean error messages. Ready to ship with minor PowerShell safety improvements.
